title: Mind the Gap! Choice Independence in Using Multilingual LLMs for Persuasive Co-Writing Tasks in Different Languages
reasoning: The paper investigates human behavior and rational choice theory in the context of AI co-writing for charity advertisements. While it discusses altruism and charitable giving, it does so as a lens for studying user reliance and persuasion rather than as a component for benchmarking or evaluating morals, religion, or ethics.
